name: Phase-Added Stereogram (PAS)
definition: PAS is an improvement over HS that introduces an extra phase factor to the hogel calculation to keep hogels in phase across the hologram, addressing the phase discontinuity issue of basic HS.
summary: Phase-Added Stereogram is a holographic method that aligns hogel phases using a depth field to improve brightness and depth of field, differing from OLAS by using non-overlapping tiles.
